import sys

MAX_SIZE = 2345678

probabilities_real = []
probabilities = []
dynamic_prog = [0.0] * MAX_SIZE
results = []
indices = []
bit_counts = [0] * MAX_SIZE

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    total_real = int(input_data[0])
    max_k = int(input_data[1])
    probabilities_real.extend(map(float, input_data[2:2+total_real]))
    results.extend([0.0] * total_real)

    valid_count = 0
    for i in range(total_real):
        if probabilities_real[i] > 1e-4:
            indices.append(i)
            probabilities.append(probabilities_real[i])
            valid_count += 1

    max_k = min(max_k, valid_count)

    for mask in range(1, 1 << valid_count):
        bit_counts[mask] = bit_counts[mask & (mask - 1)] + 1

    for mask in range(1 << valid_count):
        dynamic_prog[mask] = 0.0

    dynamic_prog[0] = 1.0

    for mask in range(1 << valid_count):
        if bit_counts[mask] == max_k:
            for j in range(valid_count):
                if mask & (1 << j):
                    results[indices[j]] += dynamic_prog[mask]
            continue
        total_prob = 0.0
        for j in range(valid_count):
            if mask & (1 << j):
                continue
            total_prob += probabilities[j]
        q_value = dynamic_prog[mask] / total_prob if total_prob != 0 else 0
        for j in range(valid_count):
            if mask & (1 << j):
                continue
            dynamic_prog[mask | (1 << j)] += probabilities[j] * q_value

    print(' '.join(f"{res:.17f}" for res in results))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
